ability.name: Cult Demagogue
ability.effect: If each dice in a casting roll for this unit has the same value and the spell is not miscast, add 3 to the casting roll.

ability.name: Illusionist
ability.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target friendly units while they are wholly within this unit’s combat range.

ability.name: Nexus of Fate
ability.effect: Roll a dice. You must replace 1 of your destiny dice with that roll.
